name: Battle

components.pose: She strides forward mid-cast with her reaper scythe in one hand and the other arm thrust out palm-first to command the dead, her cape streaming behind her, chin lifted, a fierce, commanding gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.headwear: a crown of black thorns and polished bone points
components.jewelry: a bone-and-{{METAL}} gorget set with a {{GEM}} stone, spiked bracers
components.effects: Rows of skeletal soldiers claw out of the churned mud behind her wrapped in {{MAGIC}} soul-fire, threads of necrotic energy spiralling from her palm, ghostly flames drifting across the battlefield.

notes: BATTLE: the sister in class-aligned war gear commanding her element on a battlefield of her homeland. Reuses her signature weapon.
